Name: (CR) Kisaa's Buildable Cozy Rustic Kitchen
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[left][size=3][/size][/left][center][size=4]After months of work... the [b]Buildable [/b]version of [b]Cozy Rustic Kitchen[/b] is here! Made to match the base [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30714]kitchen replacement[/url]﻿ mod with all its bells-and-whistles, plus extra items only made possible by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31678]Furniture Machine[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31678]Expanded Storage[/url]﻿. Build the Cozy Rustic kitchen of your dreams![/size]

[size=3][url=https://emojipedia.org/herb#:~:text=An%20herb%2C%20a%20plant%20used,with%20five%20or%20seven%20leaves.]🌿[/url] This mod is part of the [b]Cozy Rustic Furniture [/b]series! [url=https://emojipedia.org/herb#:~:text=An%20herb%2C%20a%20plant%20used,with%20five%20or%20seven%20leaves.]🌿
[/url]Find the rest of this series: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33318]Bakery n' Cafe

[/url][url=https://emojipedia.org/herb#:~:text=An%20herb%2C%20a%20plant%20used,with%20five%20or%20seven%20leaves.]🌿[/url] Use this furniture pack to decorate your [b]Cozy Rustic Interior[/b] spaces! [url=https://emojipedia.org/herb#:~:text=An%20herb%2C%20a%20plant%20used,with%20five%20or%20seven%20leaves.]🌿[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30038]Farmhouse [/url]﻿| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30070]Cellar[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30170/]Greenhouse[/url][/size][b][i][/i][/b][/center]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=2][b]Highly Customizable: [/b]Has all the colors and texture options from the original mod! 3 countertop styles, 2 cabinet styles, 9 wood swatches, 4 tile swatches, 6 metal swatches, 6 accent swatches... pretty sweet deal![/size]
[*][size=2][b]Toggleable Items: [/b]As there are hundreds of items across 9 wood swatches provided by this mod, you can toggle off each individual swatch to prevent unused swatches from cluttering the catalogue.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]DIY Items: [/b]A second, toggleable catalogue with its own config options is available if you want to create a variety in item swatches and texture overlays.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Config Auto-Matching Feature: [/b]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url]﻿, you can configure the items to automatically match your settings for [b]Cozy Rustic Kitchen Replacement.[/b][/size]
[*][size=2][b]Vanilla-Matching Wood Swatches: [/b]The basic wood tones includes the 4 Vanilla wood colors (Oak, Walnut, Birch, Mahogany) and comes with an extra 5 custom swatches.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Functional Appliances: [/b]The base mod has functional Stove, Sink, and Oven items that open the cooking menu.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Additional Custom Fridges: [/b]With Expanded Storage, four functional custom fridges are available, each with the standard fridge capacity.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Additional Custom Coffee/Tea Machines: [/b]With Furniture Machine, a functional coffee, espresso, and tea machine are available, with the appropriate products created every day.[/size]
[*][b][size=2]Full i18n support for ease of translation into other languages.[/size][/b]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[b]Appearance Settings[/b]

[size=2]CMCT allows you to automatically match this mod's appearance configs with Cozy Rustic Kitchen Replacement's settings for less setup effort. You can always set things manually, but [b]I highly recommend installing CMCT[/b].

[/size][list]
[*][size=2][b]AUTO SETTING IS ONLY APPLICABLE WITH CMCT AND COZY RUSTIC KITCHEN INSTALLED.[/b][/size]
[*][size=2]Otherwise, you have to manually set everything via this mod's config menu.[/size]
[*][size=2]The color of your [b]kitchen[/b] [b]cabinets[/b] will always match the [b]base counter color[/b].[/size]
[*][size=2]The color of the [b]tile accents [/b]when using the Tile countertop will always match the gingham accent colors.[/size]
[*][size=2]Certain seating, table, and shelving items can have two-toned wood colors; in which case, the [b]wood overlay color[/b] will match the [b]Wood Countertop Color[/b]. This setting is only applicable [b]when Two-Toned Furniture config is set to [i]true.[/i][/b][/size]
[*][size=2]On Auto setting, [b]custom fridge colors[/b] and [b]metal accents on clutter items[/b] will always match the [b]Kitchen Appliance Color[/b] of Cozy Rustic Kitchen Replacement.[/size]
[*][size=2]On Auto setting, [b]wood accents on clutter items[/b] will always match the[b] Base Color[/b] of Cozy Rustic Kitchen Replacement.[/size]
[*][size=2]On Auto setting, the [b]Furniture Machine base color and tabletop color[/b] match the [b]Base Color and Wood Countertop Color[/b] of Cozy Rustic Kitchen Replacement, respectively.[/size]
[/list][b]
[size=3]Modular Furniture and Rotations[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]Items whose names end with letters in brackets, e.g. (L-R), indicate modular objects.[/size]
[*][size=2][b](L-R) [/b]objects can be mirrored horizontally, while [/size][b](D-U) [/b]objects can be mirrored vertically. Right click once to rotate the object.
[*][size=2][b](C) [/b]objects are center pieces in a modular set; they cannot be put as the endpiece of a series of modular items.[/size]
[*][size=2]Some cabinet and shelving can function as edge and center objects. Cabinet and shelving with [b](R) [/b]in the name can be used as standalone items.[/size]
[*]For kitchen counter items, [b]Corner [/b]pieces must be connected to [b]Extension [/b]pieces first, before extending it with an [b]Endpiece.[/b]
[/list][b][size=2]
[/size][size=3]DIY Catalogue Items[/size][/b]

Because of how CMCT works and the way this mod is coded, the appearance settings are applied uniformly across all loaded furniture items; if you want a true full custom swatch, e.g. as a multiplayer farmhand where the appearance of your kitchen is different from the host's, you can use the [b]DIY Cozy Rustic Kitchen Catalogue [/b]and its items.

[list]
[*][size=2]The DIY items and catalogue are both toggleable; if disabled, they won't load.[/size]
[*][size=2]The appearance settings for DIY items can be found in the [b]DIY Item Customization [/b]section. [b]Auto setting is not available for DIY items.[/b][/size]
[*][size=2][b]DIY items will have DIY in the item name[/b]; however, clutter items in the DIY catalogue do not have this. But if you look up the furniture ID, the furniture ID for DIY items is different from the base items.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Functional Furniture Items[/b]

[/size]There are 3 categories of functional furniture items: (1) Items included in the base mod, (2) Custom fridges [b]only available if you have Expanded Storage installed, [/b]and (3) Custom coffee/espresso/tea machines [b]only available if you have Furniture Machine installed.[/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]The [b]Stove, Double Stove, Sink, Double Sink, [/b]and [b]Built-In Oven [/b]items included in the base mod open the cooking menu when interacted with.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Coffee Machine [/b]will produce [b]1x Coffee[/b] every day, [b]Espresso Machine [/b]produces [b]1x Triple-Shot Espresso [/b]every day, and [b]Tea Maker [/b]produces [b]1x Green Tea [/b]every day.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Fridges can be bought at Robin's. ﻿[/b]The [b]Double Fridge [/b]are two separate fridge items that should be placed next to each other; [b]each half has the same storage capacity as a vanilla Mini-Fridge.[/b][/size]
[*][size=2]If you have the dependencies installed but don't want to use the items provided in this mod, they can be enabled or disabled in config (See [b]Config Options[/b]) section.[/size]
[/list]
[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img]
[/i]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Cozy Rustic Kitchen Catalogue Price: [/b]Set your price for the catalogue item. Affects both the standard and DIY catalogue.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Enable DIY Items: [/b]Toggles the DIY catalogue and its items.[/size]
[*][size=2][b](NEW!) Two-Toned Furniture: [/b]Allows certain table, dressers, and chair items to have a two-toned wood overlay.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Enable Furniture Machines: [/b]Toggles the custom coffee, espresso, and tea machines added by this mod. [b]Only takes effect with Furniture Machine installed.[/b][/size]
[*][size=2][b]Enable Custom Fridges: [/b]Toggles the custom fridges added by this mod. [b]Only takes effect with Expanded Storage installed.[/b][/size]
[*][size=2][b]Furniture Machines Base Color: [/b]Toggles the furniture machines' base table color.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Furniture Machines Tabletop Color: [/b]Toggles the overlay on the furniture machines' tabletop color.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Oak/Walnut/Birch/Mahogany/Cream/Honey/Black/Blue/Green Items: [/b]Toggles items available based on their base wood swatch. If set to [b]false, [/b]items of this wood swatch will not appear in the catalogue.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]The following [b]Default Item Customization [/b]configs have an [b]Auto [/b]option that automatically matches item appearances with [/size][b][size=3]Cozy Rustic Kitchen Replacement's config settings:[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Buildable Kitchen Cabinet Style: [/b]Toggles between a Plain and Stripey kitchen cabinet and shelving style.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Buildable Kitchen Countertop Material: [/b]Toggles between Wood, Tile, and Metal kitchen countertops.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Buildable Kitchen Wood/Tile/Metal Countertop Color: [/b]Toggles between the available swatches of each countertop material. [b]Each setting will take effect only if the relevant Buildable Kitchen Countertop Material is selected.[/b][/size]
[*][size=2][b]Buildable Kitchen Appliances: [/b]Toggles between 6 metal swatches for kitchen appliances and metal clutter items.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Buildable Kitchen Handle Color: [/b]Toggles between 7 metal swatches for handles and knobs on all items.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Buildable Kitchen Gingham Color: [/b]Toggles between 6 gingham swatches for the gingham and Tile countertop accents.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Clutter Items Wood Color: [/b]Toggles between 9 wood swatches for wood accents on the clutter items.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]DIY Item Customization [/b]has the same config options as the above section, with the addition of:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2][b]DIY Kitchen Sink Tile Color: [/b]Toggles the tile color on Sink items when the [b]DIY Kitchen Countertop Material [/b]config is set to [b]Wood.[/b][/size]
[/list][b]
[/b][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[size=3]This mod is made for SDV 1.6. It is [b]untested on multiplayer[/b] and [b]I will not make a mobile-compatible version.[/b]

If you want to create an i18n translation for this mod, please request for my permission first here in the Posts tab or contacting me on [b]Discord (@crystalinerose).[/b]
[/size]
﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the other dependencies in the [b]Requirements [/b]tab as needed.
[*]Download and unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Buildable Kitchen" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]No known issues so far.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Please prioritize reporting any bugs on the Nexus page and follow the directions listed in the pinned comment.
[/b][/size]
